newsitem.title: CHINA: Tientsin Marine in lawsuit - statement.
newsitem.headline: Tientsin Marine in lawsuit - statement.

text.p: Shanghai-listed B share firm Tientsin Marine Shipping Co Ltd said on Tuesday it was being sued by China North Industries Corp for a payment of $5.38 million to cover two disputed consignments of cargo.

China North Corp has sued Tientsin Marine through the Qingdao Marine Court for delivering two cargoes to customers without checking the delivery documents, a statement issued by the board of directors of Tientsin Marine said.
It has demanded compensation for the total value of the goods of $5.38 million, the statement said.
"The lawsuit is still under review," the statement said. "Our company has employed lawyers to defend its legal interests. The board draws investors' attention to the lawsuit."
Trading in shares in Tientsin Marine was suspended this morning according to exchange rules. The company has also domestic A shares listed in Shanghai.
